description:
## Finding
\`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1306\` (\`names_match\` doc):
> \`TeletexString\` also uses raw DER comparison; T.61→Unicode mapping is deferred pending a clear interoperability target (see \`any_to_str_bytes\`).

\`any_to_str_bytes\` is private (\`fn any_to_str_bytes(a: &der::Any) -> Option<&[u8]>\` at L1437). The doc link works inside the crate but is not actionable for an external reader looking at the rendered docs.

## Why P4
Cosmetic / docs polish. Anyone working in the codebase knows where to look; external reader cannot click through.

## Fix
Replace the parenthetical with a free-text reference (e.g., \"see the implementation in this crate\" or \"tracked in PKIX-19l\" — use the bd issue number if there's one open).

## Scope reference
\`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1306\`.
title: P4: pkix-path/src/lib.rs T.61 deferred-work doc references private any_to_str_bytes
